notes.title: Emma's Armaments ver1.2.0 has been released!
Emma's Armaments ver1.1.6 has been released!
notes.content:
Emma's Armaments ver1.1.6 has been released.

- Adjusted some difficulty levels.
- Fixed a bug that caused inoperability during battle.

notes.title: Emma's Armaments ver 1.1.4 has been released!
notes.content:
Additional content for Emma's Armaments has been implemented.

This is a major update on the scale of the main game!
[url=https://twitter.com/GamePJ_NandT/status/1622429881006006275/photo/1][img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/FoNr-KqakAEuy5h?format= jpg&name=large[/img][/url]

Number of items 94 → 185
Alchemy patterns 53 → 118
4 additional dungeons and special dungeons implemented
Additional scenario on the scale of the main story featuring the father

The game will be released on February 7, 2012.
We will also have the game's first 30% off sale starting 2/7!
Please take this opportunity to play!

notes.title: Emma's Armaments Shop ver1.0.4 has been released!
notes.content:
The battle effects now change depending on the equipment.
The storage box has been expanded.
The F key can now be used to turn on/off the smelting mode.
The D key can now be used to open and close stores.

notes.title: Emma's Armaments ver1.0.3 has been released!
notes.content:
The UI has been adjusted to make it easier to use.
The game can be continued even after the game is cleared.

notes.title: Emma's Weapons Shop ver1.0.3 has been released!
notes.content:
The UI has been adjusted to make it easier to use.
The game can be continued even after the game is cleared.

notes.title: Ver 1.0.2 was released.
notes.content:
The character chip of Emma was incomplete, so we replaced the image with a new one.
The amount of money given by the map and customers was adjusted.

notes.title: Emma's Armaments ver1.0.1 is released.
notes.content:
Updated to ver1.0.1.
Bug fixes.

Fixed a bug that the number of smelting pattern was more than 53.
Fixed a bug that allowed users to illegally obtain money and items.
Fixed a bug that prevented the game from starting up properly when the PC language setting was other than Japanese or English.

notes.title: Emma’s Armaments was released !
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42718314/47c4beeacd141ef0ea2fc1b74df9ce5feec9e829.png[/img]

Emma’s Armaments was released !

Emma's Weapons Shop is a management simulation game in which players collect items while conquering dungeons, smelt them, and sell them at higher prices to increase sales.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42718314/39fb2643549f60ef973d2a9861b4028e50119fb5.png[/img]

Now, to celebrate the release, we are having a 20% off sale for a week from today.
Please play the game!

(Translation by deepL. The game itself is a native translation.)
